test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A solid cone of base radius 7 cm and height 18 cm is melted and recast into a hollow metal hemisphere of internal and external radii 20 cm and R cm, respectively. What is the value of R (in cm)?
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the base of the cone = 7 cm

Height of the cone = 18 cm

Internal radius of the hollow hemisphere = 20 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h

Volume of hollow hemisphere = (2/3)π(R³ - r³)

**Calculation:**

Volume of cone

⇒ (1/3)π(7)2
